plan.summary: create the load balancer "docli-web" in nyc3
steps: network: the default VPC for nyc3
targets: every droplet tagged web (now and in future)
forward http:80=http:8080  =  HTTP port 80 goes to HTTP port 8080 on the droplets
monthly cost: not shown. The API does not report load balancer prices, so docli will not guess; see DigitalOcean's pricing page. A load balancer bills while it exists
it can be provisioned for a few minutes; add --wait to wait until it is active
ownership: the name gets the prefix docli- so docli can tell it created this load balancer
